author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Rebuilt from the live app (the git repo backing this app had fallen behind — this commit brings it back in sync with the deployed v2.2.0 and adds on top): (1) Years of Service now shows years AND months instead of a bare whole-year count that read '0' for anyone under a year in. (2) Company Documents workflow permission widened to every workspace member (was admin-only) so Download actually works for everyone, not just the two admins who happened to already have access. (3) Personal (Employee) Documents remain scoped to admin-only workflow permission by design — insurance/medical/contract documents are personal, so each employee's own files are reached via a members-gated insight instead; pre-existing private files need a one-time re-upload (isPublic) to become downloadable by their owner.
